ValidationRule.description:
stop users to change the Applicant on an Application if:
Type = LICN, LICF, ADDC
AND
Phase = X, D, L, or H
AND
Profile <> System Admin
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( ISCHANGED( Applicant__c), OR(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'LICN - New License'), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'LICF - New License after Forfeiture'), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'ADDC - Additional Class')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Phase__c, 'X - Exam Phase'),ISPICKVAL(Phase__c, 'L - License Review'),ISPICKVAL(Phase__c, 'H - License Generation'), ISPICKVAL(Phase__c, 'D - Dependency Review')), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator'),true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Applicant can not be changed when application type of LICN, LICF, ADDC has Phase = X, D, L or H
